original_target.title: Full-order resonance growth for every nonzero real compact potential
original_target.area: Wave scattering by a localized medium

scope_comparison: Cunningham v2 concerns generic compactly supported potentials and maximal integrated resonance density. A generic/residual set assertion does not imply every nonzero real L-infinity compact potential. Integrated asymptotic statements also require a transfer argument to the all-large-r lower bound. Known complex counterexamples are excluded by real V.
